jobs.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Support Data Analyst to join the dbt charts team and help build the support experience for a new dbt-native BI and data visualization product.

This is not a traditional ticket-queue support role. You'll be a practicing analyst who works directly with customers to solve complex technical problems across their analytics stack - from dbt models and SQL to warehouse behavior, dashboard design, and data visualization. You'll dig into customer environments, identify root causes, build and improve dashboards, and help customers get more value from their data.

As one of the first dedicated support hires for dbt charts, you'll also help define how the support function operates as we scale. You'll turn recurring customer issues into better documentation, tooling, and product experiences while serving as a critical feedback loop between customers and Product and Engineering.

This is a full-time position based out of our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What You'll Do

Own complex customer issues from first contact through resolution across channels including Slack, email, GitHub, and live sessions.
Diagnose technical problems across dbt models and lineage, SQL and query semantics, data warehouses, permissions, dashboard configuration, and visualization.
Work directly in customer data environments to troubleshoot models, metric definitions, joins, incremental logic, and other analytics challenges.
Design and build dashboards and reference examples for customer onboarding, migrations, and best practices.
Turn recurring customer questions into clear documentation, runbooks, product improvements, and better error messages.
Act as a liaison between customers and Product and Engineering, translating customer pain into specific, reproducible, and actionable feedback.
Help build the support function, including triage processes, escalation paths, response targets, documentation, and the knowledge base.
Serve as a product subject matter expert and help onboard and coach future support team members.
Participate periodically in an on-call rotation as the customer base grows.

Skills We're Looking For

6+ years of experience in technical support, customer success engineering, technical account management, solutions engineering, analytics engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
Direct experience working with BI, analytics, data infrastructure, or modern data stack products.
Strong SQL skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex queries, joins, data models, and unexpected results.
Hands-on experience with dbt or strong analytics engineering experience with the ability to quickly become proficient in dbt.
Strong understanding of data visualization and dashboard design, including how to communicate data clearly and accurately.
Experience troubleshooting modern data warehouse environments such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, or similar technologies.
Experience owning technical customer escalations end to end and representing customer needs internally.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both customers and engineering teams.
Comfort working with Git and GitHub, including reading diffs and opening pull requests.
A builder mindset and comfort operating in an early-stage product environment where processes and systems are still being defined.
Ability to use AI-assisted tools and workflows effectively while applying sound technical judgment to their output.

Skills We're Looking For

Experience supporting a BI or dashboarding product where troubleshooting required understanding the customer's underlying data model.
Experience in the dbt or analytics engineering ecosystem.
Experience building or scaling a technical support function, particularly as an early support hire.
Experience migrating customers from an existing BI or analytics platform.
Experience creating technical documentation, runbooks, or other customer-facing educational content.
Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering on structured customer feedback and product improvements.
Experience supporting open source products or communities.
Experience with AI-assisted analytics workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, Trust & Will is the leading digital estate planning platform, trusted by over one million users. We provide modern, accessible solutions to help families protect their legacies with attorney-approved, legally valid documents tailored to individual state requirements. Our seamless online platform simplifies the estate planning and settlement process, empowering individuals to create wills and trusts while also partnering with financial advisors, attorneys, and institutions to make legacy planning more inclusive and affordable.

If you are passionate about contributing to a high-impact mission and want to work in a collaborative environment where your skills and expertise will be valued, we would love to hear from you!

About You:

You are a clear, concise communicator who can translate a complex regression or other mathematical reasoning into a one-paragraph recommendation for a non-technical stakeholder.
You are a data engineering and analyst hybrid equally comfortable building a data model and presenting the business implication to a Manager.
You have startup experience and know what it means to stand up an analytics function, ship scrappy analyses, and build toward rigor not wait for it.
You treat experimentation as a discipline, not a buzzword. You design tests, size samples, interpret results correctly, and know when an A/B test isn't the right tool.
You think in systems you connect your pipelines to business outcomes and are never satisfied stopping at the metric without asking why.
You operate with high autonomy and you identify the most important question, define the tim approach, execute the analysis, and deliver the recommendation without a detailed playbook.
You are AI-curious and actively explore how AI tools can accelerate your analytical, and data workflows, automate repetitive queries, and surface insights faster.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own the end to end analytical engine behind Trust & Will. This is a high-ownership role: you'll work across marketing, and revenue to understand what's driving conversion, retention, and lifetime value and you'll translate those findings into decisions that move the business.

This is not a reporting role. You will define the questions worth asking, build the models that answer them, guide the roadmap based on what the data shows. You'll partner closely with the Director of Data Engineering, engineering, and marketing leadership and you'll have direct access to senior stakeholders.

The core challenge is analytically interesting: estate planning is a low-frequency, high-intent product with a B2C direct channel and a growing B2B2C advisor network. Understanding how different user segments activate, convert, and retain and which levers compound requires real analytical depth.

You'll have the data, the infrastructure, and the mandate to figure it out.

Data Modeling & Integrity

Own the development of our data models within the lakehouse architecture; prioritize high-performance SQL, comprehensive documentation, and robust testing protocols.
Serve as a first line of defense for data reliability, proactively identifying and resolving upstream quality issues before they impact executive dashboards.
Architect the semantic layer and analytical structures that enable seamless self-serve exploration via AI and traditional BI platforms.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Serve as the primary data partner for marketing and engineering leadership, owning the analytical workstreams that support quarterly roadmap decisions.
Prepare and deliver data-driven recommendations to senior stakeholders and the executive team punchline first, minimum viable backstory, clear ask.
Mentor junior analysts and product/eng on methodology, communication, and prioritization; help build team-wide analytical standards.

Daily Analytical Work

For example, manage the Marketing Monitor, a 13-week rolling performance report tracking Gross Sales, multi-channel revenue (D2C, Advisor, Partnership), and unit economics (CAC, ARPM, CVR) with automated alerting.
Scale and optimize the suite of recurring analytical dashboards utilized by cross-functional leadership for weekly strategic calibration.
Guarantee data reliability and pipeline freshness; proactively interpret anomalies within an alerting framework to distinguish between statistical noise and meaningful business shifts.

Ad Hoc Analytics

Serve as the primary analytics responder for the business fielding requests from Finance, Marketing, Ops, Member Success, Partnerships, and Product. No data request is too small, but you also know when to use AI (or not).
Translate vague business questions into well-scoped analytical problems, execute them in Snowflake/SQL, and deliver findings with a clear recommendation.
Proactively surface insights from data monitoring flag anomalies, trends, or risks before stakeholders ask.
Own ticket resolution quality: well-documented queries, auditable logic, and results stakeholders can act on.

Qualifications:

Core Experience

5-9+ years of experience in analytics/data science and some data engineering or a closely related quantitative role.
Prior experience in a high-growth startup environment you've operated with limited resources, ambiguous data, and shifting priorities and delivered anyway.
Demonstrated data background: you've built data models, designed and analyzed poor data pipelines and know what good is
Experience owning a data domain end-to-end not just answering requests, but generating the questions and driving decisions.
This position is available to candidates residing in the following states only:
California (CA), Colorado (CO), Florida (FL), Georgia (GA), Idaho (ID), Illinois (IL), Maryland (MD), New Jersey (NJ), New York (NY), North Carolina (NC), Pennsylvania (PA), Texas (TX), Vermont (VT), Nevada (NV), Utah (UT)

Technical Skills

SQL
: Advanced window functions, CTEs, complex joins, query optimization on large datasets.
Python
: Proficient pandas/polars, statsmodels, scikit-learn, matplotlib/seaborn; you write clean, reproducible code.
BI / Visualization
: ThoughtSpot, Omni, or equivalent, building dashboards that enable self-serve, not just answering one-off requests.
Data Modeling
: Familiarity with dbt and the analytical data modeling - like ActivitySchema, Star Schema, etc.

Bonus Points

Experience in fintech, legaltech, insurtech, or another regulated consumer vertical.
Experience with product-led growth (PLG) motions or B2B2C business models.
Contributions to building an analytics function from scratch, including metrics frameworks, data dictionaries, and experimentation standards.
Comfort working with an AI Data Analyst tool in a self-serve analytics context.

Employee Benefits & Perks:

Compensation: Salary + Equity

Our salary range for this position is $140,000 - $180,000. In addition to compensation, we include an employee equity package as part of our offer, along with other benefits and perks outlined below.

PTO

Flexible time off that you are encouraged to use
Generous paid company holidays and breaks throughout the year
Monthly friends & family day
Paid time off to volunteer in your community

Health and Wellness Benefits

Exceptional health benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance - we cover 100% of premiums for employees and dependents on medical coverage
Mental health support through Spring Health, plus access to One Medical for primary care and Cleo for family planning and caregiving
Financial wellness benefits (unlimited 1:1 sessions with a UBS financial coach and employer-sponsored 401k with up to 4% company match)

Extra

Family-friendly work environment. We support the complexity of a remote world with the needs of families
Up to $1,000 annually in learning & development reimbursement
Optional company-sponsored events and travel throughout the year
$500 Work from home stipend + Apple accessories

Licensure/Certification/Registrations: Microsoft Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer certification preferred.

Enterprise Analytics and Reporting

Lead the design, development, validation, implementation, and ongoing optimization of enterprise reporting and analytics solutions that support clinical, operational, administrative, financial, regulatory, foundation, and strategic business functions.

Power BI and Microsoft Fabric Leadership

Design and deliver education sessions, demonstrations, and consultative support for leaders, clinicians, administrative teams, foundation staff, analysts, fellows, interns, and departmental report developers.

Serve as a consultative partner for departments seeking to modernize reports, clarify metrics, improve reporting workflows, or increase local data literacy.

About You:

You are a clear, concise communicator who can translate a complex regression or other mathematical reasoning into a one-paragraph recommendation for a non-technical stakeholder.
You are a data engineering and analyst hybrid equally comfortable building a data model and presenting the business implication to a Manager.
You have startup experience and know what it means to stand up an analytics function, ship scrappy analyses, and build toward rigor not wait for it.
You treat experimentation as a discipline, not a buzzword. You design tests, size samples, interpret results correctly, and know when an A/B test isn't the right tool.
You think in systems you connect your pipelines to business outcomes and are never satisfied stopping at the metric without asking why.
You operate with high autonomy and you identify the most important question, define the tim approach, execute the analysis, and deliver the recommendation without a detailed playbook.
You are AI-curious and actively explore how AI tools can accelerate your analytical, and data workflows, automate repetitive queries, and surface insights faster.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own the end to end analytical engine behind Trust & Will. This is a high-ownership role: you'll work across marketing, and revenue to understand what's driving conversion, retention, and lifetime value and you'll translate those findings into decisions that move the business.

This is not a reporting role. You will define the questions worth asking, build the models that answer them, guide the roadmap based on what the data shows. You'll partner closely with the Director of Data Engineering, engineering, and marketing leadership and you'll have direct access to senior stakeholders.

The core challenge is analytically interesting: estate planning is a low-frequency, high-intent product with a B2C direct channel and a growing B2B2C advisor network. Understanding how different user segments activate, convert, and retain and which levers compound requires real analytical depth.

You'll have the data, the infrastructure, and the mandate to figure it out.

Data Modeling & Integrity

Own the development of our data models within the lakehouse architecture; prioritize high-performance SQL, comprehensive documentation, and robust testing protocols.
Serve as a first line of defense for data reliability, proactively identifying and resolving upstream quality issues before they impact executive dashboards.
Architect the semantic layer and analytical structures that enable seamless self-serve exploration via AI and traditional BI platforms.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Serve as the primary data partner for marketing and engineering leadership, owning the analytical workstreams that support quarterly roadmap decisions.
Prepare and deliver data-driven recommendations to senior stakeholders and the executive team punchline first, minimum viable backstory, clear ask.
Mentor junior analysts and product/eng on methodology, communication, and prioritization; help build team-wide analytical standards.

Daily Analytical Work

For example, manage the Marketing Monitor, a 13-week rolling performance report tracking Gross Sales, multi-channel revenue (D2C, Advisor, Partnership), and unit economics (CAC, ARPM, CVR) with automated alerting.
Scale and optimize the suite of recurring analytical dashboards utilized by cross-functional leadership for weekly strategic calibration.
Guarantee data reliability and pipeline freshness; proactively interpret anomalies within an alerting framework to distinguish between statistical noise and meaningful business shifts.

Ad Hoc Analytics

Serve as the primary analytics responder for the business fielding requests from Finance, Marketing, Ops, Member Success, Partnerships, and Product. No data request is too small, but you also know when to use AI (or not).
Translate vague business questions into well-scoped analytical problems, execute them in Snowflake/SQL, and deliver findings with a clear recommendation.
Proactively surface insights from data monitoring flag anomalies, trends, or risks before stakeholders ask.
Own ticket resolution quality: well-documented queries, auditable logic, and results stakeholders can act on.

Qualifications:

Core Experience

5-9+ years of experience in analytics/data science and some data engineering or a closely related quantitative role.

Job Description

Our Commitment

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.

Who we are

As one of the fastest-growing academic health centers in the nation, Texas A&M Health encompasses five colleges and numerous centers and institutes working together to improve health through transformative education, innovative research and team-based health care delivery.

What we want

The Program Coordinator II, in partnership with the residency program director, coordinates and manages the daily activities of the Psychiatry Residency at Texas A&M. Provides curriculum delivery coordination, office management, continuous accreditation readiness, and personnel management. Serves as a liaison to program administrators, residents, faculty, and associated staff of the School of Medicine. Performs many aspects of resident and faculty recruitment, alumni relations, and promotion of the department’s comprehensive educational mission.

Responsibilities:

Program coordination, administration, and oversight

Coordinates and administers the psychiatry residency program, including creating and maintaining resident training files within various online repositories in accordance with the rules and standards established by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME), the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology (ABPN), Texas Medical Board (TMB), and other oversight bodies.
Oversees a coordinated system of faculty and resident scheduling to ensure achievement of educational objectives which complement the effective operation of a clinical enterprise while ensuring compliance with all applicable accreditation standards.
Implements a system of effective and efficient resident recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding.
May supervise office and administrative support staff in support of the program’s educational mission.
Assists in establishing short- and long-term goals, objectives and strategic plans.
Collaborates with others to create new and expanded programs.
Plans, implements, and evaluates programs.
Assists in establishing policies and procedures.
Prepares reports on program activities.

Learning Management System Administration

Serves as the program’s primary administrator of the New Innovations residency management software suite.
Coordinates the use of residency management tools within the software system and develop and deliver training to faculty and resident users.
Utilizes the learning management system to coordinate and oversee program management activities including scheduling, duty hours compliance, and resident/fellow evaluation completion.
Utilizes the New Innovations suite as the department’s primary repository for trainee files.

Business processes, administrative management, and regulatory affairs

Assists the School of Medicine in managing finances of the residency program, as necessary, in conjunction with the School’s Business and GME Offices.
Assists GME leadership at Texas A&M with administrative responsibilities related to maintenance of all Affiliation Agreements between participating sites and the sponsoring institution, Program Letters of Agreement between programs and rotation sites, and other agreements as necessary.
Oversees processes relating to resident and faculty licensure, certifications, and other regulatory affairs as required by Texas A&M Health and affiliate teaching sites.
Coordinates, develops, evaluates, and ensures adherence to office procedures to eliminate duplication of effort and streamline flow of operations.
Ensures compliance with Texas A&M University and affiliate clinical teaching sites’ administrative policies and procedures.

Accreditation Coordination

Creates a system of continuous accreditation readiness which supports the efforts of the department, program director, and GME Office to comply with the requirements and mandates set forth by the Accreditation Council of Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) and Liaison Committee for Medical Education (LCME).
Develops and implements processes which facilitate an effective Program Evaluation Committee (PEC) and Clinical Competency Committee (CCC).

Program Marketing and communication

Manages program website and both internal and external communications.
Maintains effective communication with community partners, affiliate health systems, and alumni.
Coordinates faculty and resident recruitment efforts to include participation in on- and off-site recruitment events, development of marketing materials, and overall departmental promotion.

Special events coordination

Executes and coordinates logistics for special events and projects including scheduling meetings, booking locations, assisting with transportation and lodging reservations, overseeing and managing event budgets, catering, and compiling meeting materials. Such events include but are not limited to graduation ceremonies, white coat events, and on-site recruitment activities
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Four years of residency program, medical education, or undergraduate education program coordination experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree
Five years of residency program or medical education program coordination experience; psychiatry or behavioral health program experience
Current certification from Training Administrators for Graduate Medical Education (C-TAGME)
Knowledge of and experience in instructional design and/or curriculum development
Recent experience with ACGME institutional or program site visits and CLER consultative visits.
Experience working with learning management systems including New Innovations.

Knowledge Skills & Abilities:

Knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, and database applications.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to perform all tasks and job responsibilities safely without injury to self and others in compliance with A&M System and HSC guidelines.
Ability to multi-task and work cooperatively with others.
Knowledge and experience with event planning and/or project management

Why Texas A&M University?

We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration.  Amenities associated with a major university, such as sporting and cultural events, state-of-the-art recreation facilities, the Bush Library and Museum, and much more await you.  Experience all that a big city has to offer but with a reasonable cost-of-living and no long commutes. 

Medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life and AD&D, flexible spending accounts, and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M contributing to employee health and basic life premiums
12-15 days of annual paid holidays

Health and Wellness: Free exercise programs and release time
Professional Development: All employees have access to free  LinkedIn Learning  training, webinars, and limited financial support to attend conferences, workshops, and more
Educational release time and tuition assistance for completing a degree while a Texas A&M employee
